conviction_note: Balanced evidence: a generous company cat load for H2 (FY guide 10% cat ratio vs only $12.3M of H1 cat implies ~$36M, ~15% per quarter, left for H2) gives room to beat and raise, but Q3 2026 industry personal-lines cat roughly tripled y/y at Allstate and rose at Travelers against Hippo's ~$0 Q3 2025 cat, and the stock ran +23% in 20 days to a 52-week high at the $38.25 consensus target; findings sum -0.2, p_up 49 on abs 9.0 gives -0.18, the two agree that there is no directional edge.
bar: Primary bar: company FY2026 guidance from the Q2 release of 2026-07-30 (GWP $1.65-1.70B, NWP $565-580M, revenue $580-585M, net combined ratio 99-101% incl. 10% cat loss ratio, adjusted net income $62-70M) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001828105/000182810526000041/q226earningsreleasefinal.htm . findings.finding: Hippo's own FY2026 guide leaves a large cat cushion for H2: the 10% FY cat loss ratio on roughly $480M of NEP is ~$48M, against H1 cat of $4.3M (Q1) + $8.0M (Q2, 6.7% of NEP) = $12.3M, so ~$36M (~15% cat ratio per quarter) is loaded into Q3+Q4; likewise the $62-70M adj. net income guide implies only $24-32M for H2 against $38.2M in H1 ($17.2M + $21.0M). If Q3 cat comes in at or below ~$18M, Q3 adj. NI lands near the Q1-Q2 run-rate (~$0.50+ per share) and a second FY raise is likely; the market expects at least a reaffirmation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-07-29 baseline row): beat plus a raise across every guided line, +6.87%. Q1 2026: large adjusted beat with combined-ratio guide held, -6.70%. Q4 2025: -4.89%. The stock has paid for raises, not for beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The H2 implied cat and NI arithmetic is not printed anywhere; previews quote the FY range, not the H1 vs H2 split. If the market had priced a raise, the street Q3 EPS figure would sit near the H1 run-rate rather than at $0.27 (Benzinga), which is the bottom of the guide spread across Q3 and Q4 ($0.27 + $0.64). Partly priced by the +23% run-up.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 cat $4.3M and the 13%-cat-load original guide from the Q1 release https://app.edgar.tools/filing/1828105/0001828105-26-000023/q126earningsreleasefinal.htm ; the June 2026 reinsurance renewal cut net PMLs 31-36% https://www.reinsurancene.ws/hippo-hails-2026-reinsurance-overhaul-as-structural-evolution-in-move-to-enterprise-wide-cat-program/ . Shares the Q2 release with no other finding.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 was a heavy personal-lines cat quarter in the US: Allstate booked $1.65B pre-tax cat in Q3 2026 (July $682M, August $748M, September $220M) against $558M in Q3 2025, and Travelers' Q3 cat rose to $538M from $302M on wind and hail, driven largely by late-July SCS and the 9-12 August derecho across Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio and Kentucky; Illinois is among the states Hippo's 10-K lists in its GWP breakdown, and Hippo's own Q3 2025 cat was -$0.3M, so the y/y loss-ratio comparison deteriorates. Sized small because Hippo's exposure is mostly ceded and the H2 cat load (finding 1) is ~15% per quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2025 (LA wildfires, $53.4M cat, 105.9% net loss ratio) printed 2025-05-07: -15.90%. Q3 2024 cat $16.1M; Q3 2025 cat ~$0 printed 2025-11-04: +5.46%. Cat surprises are the line this stock has moved most on.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission that Hippo has not confirmed; no Hippo cat pre-announcement. If the market had priced a heavy Q3 cat hit the stock would not have run +23% into the print to a 52-week high. Counterweight: global 9M26 cat is the lowest since 2019 (Gallagher Re), and Moody's RMS says Texas hail reports were down ~70% in H1 2026, so Hippo's TX/CA-heavy homeowners book may have missed the Midwest events.
findings.independence: Travelers Q3 2026: cat $538M vs $302M, wind and hail https://www.reinsurancene.ws/travelers-q326-net-income-rises-despite-higher-cat-losses-but-9m-cat-toll-down-considerably/ ; derecho geography https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/us/news/catastrophe/midwest-derecho-pushes-2026-us-storm-losses-past-35-billion-brokers-say-586429.aspx ; Hippo Q3 2025 cat -$0.3M https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828105/000182810525000066/quarterlyinvestorupdatet.htm . findings.finding: Accelerant, which Hippo's management said would bring more than $500M of premium to Hippo next year, grew third-party direct written premium to 47% of its $1.32B Q2 2026 exchange written premium from 27% a year earlier (~+115% y/y, ~$621M vs ~$290M), reported after Hippo last spoke; supports Hippo's guided H2 GWP acceleration in the fronting platform. Accelerant is being taken private by Thoma Bravo, which could change that partner relationship later.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GWP raises have come with the cat-led profit raises (Q2 2026 +6.87%); no isolated GWP surprise in the history.

findings.finding: Hippo's 1 June 2026 reinsurance renewal moved to a group catastrophe structure with its first whole-account quota share, $513M first-event and $777M aggregate limit, 15-20% risk-adjusted rate decreases and a 31-36% reduction in net PML; Q3 2026 is the first full quarter under it, lowering ceded cost and capping net cat from the Q3 SCS events.

findings.why_not_priced: Public since June and folded into the July guide raise (cat load cut from 13% to 10%), so most of it is in the guide; the residual is how much it cut Q3 net cat from the Midwest events, which only the print shows. CEO said the quota share cession is 'very small'.

baseline_tension: The skew (+35 downside paid) and the +23% run-up both lean against an up move, and finding 2 (heavy Q3 industry cat) agrees with them, while finding 1 (the generous H2 cat load and the room to raise) cuts against them. The chain is too illiquid (OI 319, 37% spread) to give the skew much weight, so p_up sits at 49 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar): the street Q3 EPS bar is single-source and disputed (Benzinga adj $0.27 vs GuruFocus GAAP basis), so the guidance-cushion finding is anchored on the company guide and trimmed from +1.5 to +1.2.

Rule 6 (inside the guide) and rule 5 (proxy): the Q3 industry-cat finding lands inside the ~15%-per-quarter H2 cat load the company already guided to and is a macro proxy, so it is shrunk from -1.0 to -0.6.
Rule 7 (positioning): short interest checked (4.3 DTC, not crowded) and the skew judged weak on an illiquid chain; the run-up finding is trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8.

Rule 6 (inside the guide): the Accelerant (+0.3 to +0.2), reinsurance (+0.4 to +0.2) and softening-market (-0.2 to -0.1) findings were all already in or disclosed with the July guide, so each is moved toward 0.
Rule 1 (reaction history): Q1 2026's large beat was sold -6.7% and only the Q2 raise was bought, so p_up is moved from 48 to 49 rather than reading a beat as a rise; abs_move_pct is left at 9.0.
